paper_title: Projected sensitivities of the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment to new physics via low-energy electron recoils
notes: Projected 90% CL sensitivity for LZ (5.6t 1000d) to galactic axion-like particles via axio-electric effect. Text states a scan over ALP masses 2-70 keV/c2 constrains g_Ae to no larger than ~7.6e-14 at ~64.3 keV (the 124Xe KK peak energy). Only this single best-limit value is given numerically in text; the exclusion curve varies with mass but individual points are not tabulated. The paper also reports a solar axion axio-electric limit g_Ae as low as 1.58e-12 (mass-independent solar axion, different production mechanism) and a hidden photon limit kappa^2 ~7.4e-28. Given multiple couplings discussed, extraction confidence is moderate.
